capabilities_done: slice 1 retouch::content_aware_fill(target, region) = content_aware::fill(target, region, SamplingArea::Auto, ContentAwareOptions::default(), RetouchLimits::default()).result (bytes equal, test retouch_content_aware_fill_is_the_native_fill); canvas_ops::crop with content_aware_fill_on_expand = native fill of the exposed pixels (opaque bounds mask cropped the same way has alpha < 1; crop pixel composited source-over the fill so a partly exposed rotated edge keeps its visible part); keep-pixels (angle 0) grows the plane to the union of moved plane and canvas, synthesizes every union pixel outside the moved plane (sampling = the moved plane only), then returns the non-canvas ones to transparent; canvas_ops::crop_content_aware(plane, rect, CropOptions, &ContentAwareOptions, limits) -> (CanvasResult, Option<ContentAwareReceipt>); RetouchError::ContentAwareUnsupported no longer produced by pigment (variant kept)

slice 2 STU-RAS-143 search adaptations in content_aware::fill/patch(content-aware)/move: colour_adaptation high (gain 0.9..1/0.9, |bias| <= 0.1) and very_high (gain 0.75..1/0.75, |bias| <= 0.25) = per-channel gain/bias fitted per candidate (g = clamp(sd_t/sd_s), b = clamp(mean_t - g mean_s), Image Melding 2012) and applied in the vote, plus the default healing blend; rotation_adaptation low 15 / medium 45 / high 90 / full 180 deg in 5 deg steps, scale 2^(k/8) |k| <= 3, mirror (horizontal before rotation) = transformed patches c + s R(theta) diag(+-1,1) o sampled bilinearly, admissible only when every non-zero tap may be sampled; Generalized PatchMatch propagation (source moved by the transformed step), random search tries best transform + a perturbed one (separate SplitMix64 streams: no-adaptation bytes unchanged, content_aware 8/8 identical numbers); parent init carries the transform with the child parity through it; work charge x cost_factor (2 colour, 4 transform, 8 both) and 2 candidates per random draw; byte charge refined to 64 B/pixel + 96 B per possible domain centre (min(pixels, hole x patch area)); ContentAwareOptions::adapts_search; patch PatchMode::Normal refuses any adaptation content_aware_option_unsupported (no search to adapt); DESCRIPTOR version 2

slice 3 content_aware::scale::content_aware_scale(plane, new_width, new_height, protect Option<&CoveragePlane>, limits) -> ScaleResult{plane (x, y, new_w, new_h), ScaleReceipt{removed/inserted columns/rows, protected_crossings, work}} (re-exported from content_aware): seam carving from Avidan-Shamir 2007 (energy L1 gradient of premultiplied RGBA + protect coverage x 8 x (max(w,h)+1) so one protected pixel outweighs any unprotected seam; DP 8-connected least-energy seam, first minimum, back-track x-1/x/x+1; narrowing one seam at a time; widening duplicates the seams a narrowing would remove (premultiplied mean with the right neighbour, protection max) in steps of at most half the width; width then height via transpose); bytes (96 B per cell of the largest grid + output) and work (seams x larger side x other side x 4, widening rebuild) charged before allocation; content_aware::inpaint(target, mask, options, limits) = fill(.., SamplingArea::Auto, ..); DESCRIPTOR keys scale and inpaint
